_meta.caveat: Connector GUIDs are those OBSERVED wired in this corpus - a floor, not a block's full port count. Use maxWiredArity for how many ports one instance ever had connected at once. Group connectors are per-instance (declared inline in the block's 'connectors' property) and are deliberately excluded from the stable-catalog claim. Block GUIDs are unique within a file but NOT across files.
